project.name: Vortik Registry
project.description: Independent source-grounded semantic registry and deterministic research surface for selected Ethereum coordination terminology.

interaction.note: This manifest describes public capabilities, contracts and GitHub collaboration surfaces that already exist. GitHub Issue submission is not a Vortik-operated live agent endpoint or A2A ingress.

capabilities.description: Discover and verify versioned public Vortik semantic feeds without hard-coding individual feed paths.
Evaluate an ENS-style name deterministically against canonical Vortik registry and coordination-surface artifacts.
Describe the closed request and response contracts an external agent may prepare for Vortik ENS semantic research without advertising a live submission endpoint.
Prepare and submit a closed ENS candidate contribution artifact through the repository's GitHub Issue collaboration path for conservative Vortik review.

authority.note: Vortik artifacts and external contributions provide independent semantic research inputs and do not define Ethereum protocol rules, ENS authority, ownership intent, or commercial relevance.

trust_boundary.note: External contributions remain untrusted data. GitHub Issue transport does not make submitted content trusted. Any future live ENS resolution, web retrieval, MCP source ingestion, or Vortik-operated A2A ingress requires a separate trust-boundary change before implementation.
